name: Pestec International Berhad
overview: 2026年，Pestec International Berhad 未公告任何业务扩张、新业务或合约。主要事件为子公司 Pestech Sdn. Bhd. 遭 Pestech Engineering Technology (China) Co. Ltd. 提出清盘呈请（涉及约 USD 2,394,052.01），该呈请已于2026年11月5日撤回。此外，公司收到审计报告中的持续经营相关重大不确定性说明。
overview_en: In 2026, Pestec International Berhad did not announce any business expansion, new business, or contracts. The main event was a winding-up petition filed by Pestech Engineering Technology (China) Co. Ltd. against its subsidiary Pestech Sdn. Bhd. (amounting to approximately USD 2,394,052.01), which was withdrawn on 5 November 2026. In addition, the company received an audit report with a material uncertainty related to going concern.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 2026年集团层面主要涉及子公司清盘呈请及审计报告中的持续经营重大不确定性说明。
segments.note_en: In 2026, the Group mainly dealt with a winding-up petition against its subsidiary and a material uncertainty related to going concern in the audit report.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Pestech Engineering Technology (China) Co. Ltd. 于2026年11月5日撤回对 Pestech Sdn. Bhd. 的清盘呈请，法院据此撤销该呈请。
actions.text_en: Pestech Engineering Technology (China) Co. Ltd. withdrew the winding-up petition against Pestech Sdn. Bhd. on 5 November 2026, and the Court accordingly struck out the petition.

actions.title: AUDIT REPORT - MODIFIED OPINION / MATERIAL UNCERTAINTY RELATED TO GOING CONCERN : QUALIFIED OPINION
actions.text: 公司2026年年报审计报告载有与持续经营相关的重大不确定性说明（保留意见）。
actions.text_en: The audit report for the 2026 annual report contains a material uncertainty related to going concern (qualified opinion).

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 该清盘呈请仍在吉隆坡高等法院审理中，Pestech Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年5月26日提交中止诉讼申请。
actions.text_en: The winding-up petition remains pending before the High Court of Kuala Lumpur, and Pestech Sdn. Bhd. filed a stay application on 26 May 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 Pestech Sdn. Bhd. 于2025年12月22日遭 Pestech Engineering Technology (China) Co. Ltd. 提出清盘呈请，涉及金额约 USD 2,394,052.01。
actions.text_en: A winding-up petition was filed by Pestech Engineering Technology (China) Co. Ltd. against wholly-owned subsidiary Pestech Sdn. Bhd. on 22 December 2025, involving an amount of approximately USD 2,394,052.01.
